Feature.Description: ILCS device task contract in SiLA 2 form. Actions are submitted and then polled by the ILCS CommandId; the device never needs to know about batches or workflows. Submit returns as soon as the device has accepted (or rejected) the task; long-running work is observed through QueryTask.

Command.Description: Submit an action. Returns state accepted/running when the device has taken the task, done when it finished synchronously.

Parameter.Description: Stable command identifier issued by ILCS. A device that implements de-duplication MUST return the existing task for a repeated CommandId instead of acting twice.
JSON object of step parameters. Matrix plans add params.wells = {well: {param: value}}.
JSON object: batch_id, step_index, step_id, target_command_id.

Response.Description: JSON receipt: command_id (echo), state (accepted|running|done|failed|unknown|not_found), device_ts (ISO-8601 with offset), quality (good|bad|uncertain), delivered (object; delivered.materials lists actual material consumption), telemetry (list of {metric, value, setpoint}), error (string).

Command.Description: Return the current receipt of a task by the ILCS CommandId; state not_found if the device never saw it.

Parameter.Description: Stable command identifier issued by ILCS. A device that implements de-duplication MUST return the existing task for a repeated CommandId instead of acting twice.

Response.Description: JSON receipt: command_id (echo), state (accepted|running|done|failed|unknown|not_found), device_ts (ISO-8601 with offset), quality (good|bad|uncertain), delivered (object; delivered.materials lists actual material consumption), telemetry (list of {metric, value, setpoint}), error (string).

Command.Description: Hold the in-flight action named by TargetCommandId.

Parameter.Description: Stable command identifier issued by ILCS. A device that implements de-duplication MUST return the existing task for a repeated CommandId instead of acting twice.
The in-flight action command this control request applies to.

Response.Description: JSON receipt: command_id (echo), state (accepted|running|done|failed|unknown|not_found), device_ts (ISO-8601 with offset), quality (good|bad|uncertain), delivered (object; delivered.materials lists actual material consumption), telemetry (list of {metric, value, setpoint}), error (string).

Command.Description: Abort the in-flight action named by TargetCommandId and bring the device to a safe state.

Parameter.Description: Stable command identifier issued by ILCS. A device that implements de-duplication MUST return the existing task for a repeated CommandId instead of acting twice.
The in-flight action command this control request applies to.

Response.Description: JSON receipt: command_id (echo), state (accepted|running|done|failed|unknown|not_found), device_ts (ISO-8601 with offset), quality (good|bad|uncertain), delivered (object; delivered.materials lists actual material consumption), telemetry (list of {metric, value, setpoint}), error (string).

Property.Description: JSON object: device_id, model, serial, firmware, simulator (true only for simulated devices), interlock (bool), accepts_commands (bool), device_ts.
